name: Chest Organizer
author: BestCode
description: Shared chests: several players can have the same chest open at once. The host owns what every chest holds and checks every item move (the slot must still hold what the player saw), so a refused move is undone and nothing is ever duplicated. Items taken from closed chests (Craft From All Storage) are merged on the host. The host sorts every chest on the raft by crafting category on its own while nobody has a chest open; the Sort and put-everything-in buttons are hidden. Console: arrumar | arrumar status.
